about: [O2] Memory in the traffic (brief O2 §5: memory flat after ten minutes in traffic): the drive-through's loop through every district twice (11 minutes a loop), the heap after a collection and the renderer's geometries, textures and programs taken at the start, at the end of the first loop and at the end of the second - the same place, the same streets round it: the second no more than the first (heap within 6 %, geometries within 10 %, programs and textures not growing). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o2_memory.json

steps.check: D.end === 'done' && D.mem.length === 3 && D.mem[2].heapMB < D.mem[1].heapMB * 1.06 && D.mem[2].geo < D.mem[1].geo * 1.1 && D.mem[2].prog <= D.mem[1].prog + 2 && D.mem[2].tex <= D.mem[1].tex + 2
steps.label: memory flat: after the second loop (or as far as it got in its time) no more than after the first
